notes.text: Akhenaten, also spelled Akhenaton, Echnaton, and Khuenaten, was an ancient Egyptian pharaoh reigning c. 1353–1336 or 1351–1334 BC, the tenth ruler of the Eighteenth Dynasty.
Originally named Amenhotep IV, in the fifth year of his reign he adopted the name "Akhenaten".
Akhenaten is remembered as a politician connected with Egypt.
Akhenaten's recorded life dates place this profile around -1400--1336.
Akhenaten is grouped with Justice, Governance & Leadership in the People Library.
